verdict.rationale: The GitHub README says one line of code logs requests from OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain, Gemini, the Vercel AI SDK and more. The docs show the OpenAI SDK path in detail (two lines added to existing OpenAI code). Community users confirm the one-line OpenAI swap and say it helped them debug LangChain chains. Missing for 10: dedicated first-party docs for the LangChain and Vercel AI SDK integrations (only a README mention), and hands-on corroboration of the Vercel AI SDK integration.
